sources.snippet: The GLM-4.5 series models are foundation models designed for intelligent agents. GLM-4.5 has 355 billion total parameters with 32 billion active parameters, while GLM-4.5-Air adopts a more compact design with 106 billion total parameters and 12 billion active parameters. sources.title: zai-org/GLM-4.5 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The GLM-4.5 ecosystem provides multiple model variants optimized for different deployment scenarios. Each core model (GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air) includes base versions, chat-optimized versions, and FP8 quantized variants for memory-efficient deployment.
